conceptZh: 一個發條玩具人昂首闊步地往前走，發條轉到底後越走越慢，最後整個定格在抬腳的姿勢動彈不得；一隻手伸進來幫牠重新上緊發條，牠立刻「噠噠噠」精神抖擻地繼續走，走過的路線就變成「走」字。
morph: the toy’s path settles into the 土 on top and the 龰 below, forming 走
creativeAngle: 走路本身就是字義，用發條走到沒力定格在半空的姿勢當笑點，停頓的那一秒最好笑。走只有七畫且上下結構清楚，適合做真正的組裝。語音詞「走路」，走ㄗㄡˇ、路ㄌㄨˋ都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale mint background. Centered, a chunky wind-up walking toy with a big key in its back strides across the frame with tremendous purpose, arms swinging, chin high. From 1.2 seconds it begins to slow: the key turns more and more lazily, the strides shorten, the swinging arms sag. At 2.2 seconds it stops dead, frozen mid-step with one foot still raised in the air and a completely blank expression. Hold that ridiculous pose. At 3.0 seconds a small hand reaches in from the left, winds the key several brisk turns, and withdraws. The toy snaps back to life and marches off with renewed dignity, and the bright path it walks stays behind it: a short upright crossed by two horizontal bars settling at the top of frame, and beneath them a long horizontal base with an upright and a sweeping stroke to the right. The toy marches out of frame at 4.4 seconds. By 4.8 seconds the path has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 走 in saturated deep rust orange, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins, its upper 土 and lower part clearly separated and every stroke crisp. From 4.9 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 走 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「走、走、走路」, using the reading ㄗㄡˇ for 走 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 走 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 走路 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 走: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
